components: skippy runtime that splits the layers across the mesh
architecture_facts: the skippy runtime splits the layers across the mesh when a model is too big for one machine
it serves the mesh as one openai endpoint on localhost 9337
single machine fit is tried first then it spills the overflow to peers
peers pool their gpus and memory over iroh
iroh is a nat-traversing peer-to-peer transport so there is no central server
it plugs into claude code goose opencode and pi as one openai endpoint
written in rust and licensed apache-2.0
surprising_detail: It tries to fit the whole model on your own machine first and only spills the overflow layers onto peer machines over the mesh, so nothing leaves home unless the model is genuinely too big to hold.
